reviewer: assistant visual inspection of all 10 fixed dual-camera contact sheets
sample_rule: first numeric train demo, five floor-linspace timesteps
stove_observation: Bowl, plate and moving gripper remain distinguishable in at least one view at each fixed time. Wrist bowl/plate edges are partially cropped, but agentview retains the manipulation area. Blur3 reduces edge precision; noise012 adds substantial grain; neither creates a blank or globally saturated image. Combo is more degraded but gross target and gripper locations remain visible.
drawer_observation: Agentview retains cabinet and approaching/opening gripper. Wrist handle is near image boundary in initial/late frames also in Clean; middle-drawer handle is visible in agentview or wrist at the corresponding sampled times. Blur3 weakens small handle detail but does not erase cabinet/handle region in both views. Crop075 removes some peripheral content but not all task-critical content across both views. No channel reversal or global severe saturation observed.
limitation: Necessary visual information-retention screen only, not a proof of learnability or guaranteed visibility along future policy trajectories. No result-based trial exclusion permitted. No policies or success rates used for admission.
